column5: BEST-VERIFIED SECTION IN THE CASINO: 6 of 9 frames verified `match` against measured DOM, not by eye - board 9163-4529 (tile 103.047 vs Figma 103.0408, gap 11.437 vs 11.449, radius 5.152 and border 3.4347 exact, ring colours #FF574A bomb / #17F9B4 gem on a constant #001615 tile, the frame's 150%/135.48% BOMB_CROP rather than a plain cover, committed gem.png/bomb.png and one extracted tile-bolt.svg), mobile board 9163-6955 holding the identical 0.1111 gap/tile ratio, bet panel Advanced-off 9163-7155 (every label verbatim, Mines: is the frame's combobox and the DOM reports no input[type=range], CTA 324x52 #56C7F3 radius 16), Advanced-Auto 9163-7972 (all six advanced labels), and both mobile panel states 9163-8481 / 9163-8621 including the frame's CTA-above-toggle inversion. The 4 page frames stay `partial` for reasons already on record: 9003-110110 tablet A is the REJECTED rival of B (A's 708-wide letterbox board with Manual/Auto above the CTA contradicts both B and mobile, so only B's shape was built) and 9163-5572's own info-block title and card art read 'Dice' - designer leftovers deliberately not reproduced, along with its clipped Dice trio below the frame bottom. ★ 2026-08-05 - BOTH previously-recorded wrong controls are now CLEARED, and the Potential Profit number was wrong TWICE for two different reasons. (1a) EDGE, fixed earlier (2cc8e0e): MinesGame.tsx floored at *98 (2%) against the rail's MINES_EDGE_BPS=9500 (_shared/mines.ts:126), quoting 1.46x where 1.4188x settles. (1b) ROUNDING, fixed now: the corrected client still floored to TWO DECIMALS (`Math.floor(mult * 95) / 100`) while the rail floors to ONE BPS (_shared/mines.ts:279-281, exact BigInt `Number(num / den)`), so 3 mines / 3 reveals printed 1.41x against a settled 1.4188x - low, never high, so no player was shortchanged, but still a number the rail contradicts. MinesGame.tsx:144-148 and MinefieldPro.tsx:120-121 now both delegate to a new pure module minesOdds.ts, a port of the rail's BigInt ladder rather than a second derivation of it, and minesOdds.test.ts pins it to bps values LIFTED FROM PRODUCTION points_game_rounds rows (10795 at 3 mines/1 reveal, 12337 at 3/2, 14188 at 3/3, 19166 at 3/5, 11875 at 5/1, 15000 at 5/2, 980448 at 6/12 where a 1000-point stake paid 98044) plus a source-text guard on MINES_EDGE_BPS / MINES_TILES in the edge function - an oracle the client cannot satisfy by agreeing with itself. The same pass floored the PAYOUT surfaces the integer POINTS rail floors: potentialProfit and the `Cash Out N` CTA both route through minesPayout(), because fmtAmount rounds POINTS half-up and a raw 10.795 printed 'Cash Out 11' against a settlement of 10. (2) GRID SIZE is honest rather than wired, and that is deliberate: the rail genuinely cannot take it. _shared/mines.ts hardcodes MINES_TILES=25 into the Pascal table, the Fisher-Yates board, the tile-range validation and the ladder; points-game mines_start (index.ts:3840-3860) accepts betAmount/mineCount/clientSeed and NO gridSize; pointsGameService.startPointsMines has no such parameter and gameSettlementService.ts:1624-1631 drops the field. minesTheme.LIVE_RAIL_GRID_SIZES=[25] now gates the control - all four design segments still render, 36/49/Custom are DISABLED with the reason on the control, and the pre-bet quote can no longer price a 64-tile ladder the server settles as 25. Widening it is an engine change plus an edge-function deploy, not a UI change; widen LIVE_RAIL_GRID_SIZES the day the engine takes a board size. ★ MinefieldPro.tsx is no longer mounted anywhere (Play.tsx and PlayNewReleases.tsx route Mines to MinesGame via MinesPage); it was corrected anyway so a remount cannot resurrect the divergence. ★ STILL OPEN, not a frame gap: the ADMIN key mines_house_edge (default 0.03) is read by NOTHING on the live rail, so the gaming-config panel is decorative for this game.
